caption: The drawing depicts six rectangular swatches arranged in two columns and three rows on an off-white background. Each swatch contains a different decorative pattern primarily using shades of maroon, pink, brown, and white. The top left swatch features a repeating floral pattern with red and white flowers and small red dots on a maroon background. The top right swatch displays horizontal pink and beige stripes, each stripe adorned with alternating pink and dark brown stylized flowers. The middle left swatch consists of a geometric pattern with diagonal intersecting lines forming diamond shapes in maroon, pink, and white, with mini diamonds inside the larger ones. The middle right swatch shows a brown and white diagonal striped background overlaid with a looping white and pink ribbon motif and a border of stylized flowers on the top and bottom. The bottom left swatch contains a maroon background scattered with dot patterns and abstract shapes in cream, black, and pink that resemble stylized insects or bows. The bottom right swatch presents a large-scale diamond pattern alternating between solid brown and finely striped beige and pink sections.
title: Materials from Quilt
